description: Return the default Safe ownership plan for an agent EOA: threshold 1 + agent + selected recovery (1/2 when one recovery is set). Call before register_intent for Safe deploys. AgentWatch never deploys or signs.

agent_key.description: Agent EOA that will be an owner/signer

all_recoveries.description: If true, include all matching recoveries (1/n) instead of just the default one

chain.description: Optional chain hint for the intent constraints

recovery_label.description: Optional label to pick among several recoveries

name: get_safe_defaults
